final_message:
Fixed. `npm test` now passes all 3 tests, including the accented-title case.

**The change:** `src/blog/slug.js` now splits accented letters into a base letter plus a combining mark (NFD), strips the marks, then calls the existing `slugify`. "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`.

**Why here and not in the vendor code:** `vendor/slugify/index.js` deletes any character outside `a-z0-9`, which is why "è" and "û" disappeared. Its header and `vendor/README.md` say not to edit vendored files by hand, so I left it alone. The only file changed is `src/blog/slug.js`.

**Not changed:** `src/shop/product-url.js` uses the same vendored `slugify`, so product URLs still drop accents (e.g. "Crème" becomes "crme"). I didn't touch that because it's outside this task. If you want shop URLs fixed too, the same normalization could go there, or the fix could go upstream in the vendored library.
